name: 7/21 EMA Crossover with Stop Loss
description: Trend-following strategy that enters long positions when the 7-day EMA crosses above the 21-day EMA and exits when it crosses below. Uses a 2% stop loss and fixed $1000 position sizing per trade.
source:
# Data source
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Calculate EMAs
ema_7 = ma(period=7, type=MAType.ema)(close)
ema_21 = ma(period=21, type=MAType.ema)(close)

# Entry/Exit signals
entry_signal = crossover(ema_7, ema_21)
exit_signal = crossunder(ema_7, ema_21)

# Hold position from entry to exit
held_long = hold_until()(enter=entry_signal, exit=exit_signal)

# Execute long positions
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long)

# Position sizing - $1000 notional per trade
position_size(type="notional")(size=1000)

# Stop loss - 2%
stop_loss(unit="percent")(distance=2)
